speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing right leg weakness, an unsteady gait, multiple falls, forgetfulness, and paranoid behavior. To help me understand the timeline of your symptoms, when did these issues first begin?

speaker: Patient
text: 44-year-old male. The patient's daughter reports a 1-week history of right leg weakness, unsteady gait, and multiple falls. Over the past 6 months, the patient has been increasingly forgetful, losing his way on familiar routes and facing difficulties operating simple kitchen appliances. He has also been paranoid, agitated, and restless recently.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Not yet determined, I need to narrow this down further. Given the combination of subacute memory loss, behavioral changes (paranoia), and focal motor weakness, could you clarify if the leg weakness is purely physical or if he experiences confusion when attempting to walk?
